name: Mixed-layout display with typed KV prefix reuse
runtime: Swift Release / MLX; retained model and common grammar preparation per cycle

environment.COMMITER_184_SCOPE_POLICY: caller-supplied JSON array derived from internal/planning/schema.go allowedTypes

input_contract.host: original canonical data and identifiers retained; projection deep-copies request
input_contract.ipc: strict outer JSON; literal-newline display escaped by outer serializer
input_contract.projection_source: finalized 3-message mixed-layout wires, before the four cleanup experiments; fail closed on unsupported representation

layout.grouping_text: same common system then full files/raw_diff/change_blocks/history; phase-specific instructions/schema and references follow
layout.category: own system with classification rules, history data, then phase instructions/schema and full file evidence inside each group; no shared files

adopted_changes.change: one complete output Schema in each prompt; retain runtime grammar Schema and field/type/required descriptions
Category classification/breaking/docs rules only in Category system; remove Grouping/Text rules and identical Category user repetition
omit phase payload task/schema_version and empty user_requests from model display; preserve nonempty user_requests
omit block_id/execution_ref from model display only; retain host identifiers

input_contract.preserved: full raw_diff including headers/@@/+/- and literal LF; diff_range; file_id/group_id/context_ref/mentioned_file_ids; uncertainty and safety rules
input_contract.projection_is_lossy: source is retained separately; omitted fields cannot be reconstructed from projected display alone

limitations: one fixture/seed and one run per model/arm
fixed phase inputs, not propagated E2E
Qwen Text differs: numerical equivalence not established; adoption does not resolve this uncertainty
KV plans remain model/runtime-specific and must be audited; no blanket enablement for other models

prefix_reuse.dispatch: runtime concrete cache type, not model name
prefix_reuse.activation: matching model/runtime record and exact token prefix; unknown types/settings/prefix mismatch use normal prefill

model_validation.Qwen3.5-4B: fixture pass; Text differs; exact generation equivalence not established
